Difficulty bands are provisional agent judgments about the stated contribution/validation burden for an appropriately scoped manuscript within its research area. They are not measured acceptance odds, a general quality ranking or a cross-disciplinary prestige score. Moderate never means easy. Unknown and not_comparable are deliberate outputs.

Eight Springer homepages disclose 2025 Journal Impact Factor and 5-year Journal Impact Factor values; first-decision medians are displayed without a metric year or defined sample period. Their null years are preserved. Bibliometric raw numerator/denominator counts were not supplied by those pages.

Bioinformatics supplies 2025 citation values, a category rank with its 67-journal denominator and decision medians. OUP explicitly defines the decision medians as decision-year cohorts including desk rejections. Category ranks and citations were kept separate from editorial difficulty.

BIOMATH acceptance is officially reported as 23% for 2025 and 36% aggregate for 2012-2025 (14 years), but neither source specifies the denominator, date-cohort rule, article mix, handling of withdrawals/desk rejections or counts. The rates are context only and are not treated as personal probabilities.

Biometrical Letters official publishing-platform page reports 20% rejection with no year or denominator and displays undated citation metrics. No 80% acceptance complement, current-year assignment or difficulty inference is made from those figures.

PLOS central metrics page text extraction omits the image labels associating individual journal cards. Direct HTTPS access returned 403. Unresolved card identity is recorded and those numerical values are omitted pending unambiguous official card verification.

PCJ final journal transfer is conditional on a prior successful PCI recommendation; recommendation itself involves selection and peer review. Central all-PCI counts cannot be used as this journal or this subfield acceptance rate. JOSS needs mature research software and current public-development/impact gates; ease of drafting its short paper is not evidence of easy acceptance.

Sources were checked live on 2026-11-16. Official page disclosure and independent agent review do not replace manuscript-specific scientific review. Missing statistics are not evidence that a venue is accessible. No venue contacted and no submission made.
